jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer – Humanoid Robotics
jobs.description:
About CNTXT AI

CNTXT AI is a UAE-based Data & AI company delivering end-to-end AI solutions and services to enterprises and leading AI organizations globally.
Our capabilities include AI training data, robotics and embodied AI, human data collection, data annotation, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), computer vision, and advanced machine learning.
As we expand our robotics operations in the United States, we are building advanced infrastructure to support humanoid robot development, testing, teleoperation, and robotic data collection.
We are seeking a Senior Robotics Engineer – Humanoid Robotics
to join our Milpitas office and help build and scale our robotics engineering capabilities.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Senior Robotics Engineer with extensive experience working directly with humanoid robotic platforms.
You will be responsible for developing, integrating, testing, and optimizing humanoid robotic systems, with a strong focus on robotic manipulation, motion planning, teleoperation, control systems, and embodied AI data collection.
The ideal candidate has experience taking robotic systems beyond simulation into real-world environments and can independently troubleshoot complex hardware and software challenges.
You will collaborate with Robotics, AI Research, Hardware Engineering, and Data Operations teams to develop reliable robotic systems and scalable data collection infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

1. Humanoid Robotics Engineering & Integration
Lead the integration, configuration, and development of humanoid robotic platforms.
Work directly with robotic arms, dexterous hands, actuators, sensors, and control systems.
Develop and optimize humanoid robot capabilities for manipulation, locomotion, and physical interaction.
Integrate robotic hardware, software, embedded systems, and perception modules.
Troubleshoot complex mechanical, electrical, and software integration issues.
Evaluate new humanoid platforms, components, and technologies.
Support robot deployment, calibration, maintenance, and operational readiness.

2. Robot Motion Planning & Control
Develop and implement motion planning and control algorithms for humanoid robots.
Work on forward and inverse kinematics, robot dynamics, trajectory optimization, and whole-body control.
Develop joint-level control and coordinated robotic movement.
Improve balance, stability, locomotion, and manipulation performance.
Integrate motion planning with perception and autonomous task execution.
Optimize real-time robotic control for accuracy, reliability, and responsiveness.

3. Robotic Manipulation & Dexterous Systems
Develop manipulation capabilities for robotic arms, hands, and grippers.
Implement grasp planning, object manipulation, and bimanual coordination.
Integrate force, torque, tactile, and visual feedback into robotic control.
Develop robotic capabilities for interacting with everyday objects, tools, and industrial environments.
Improve manipulation accuracy, task completion rates, and repeatability.
Support imitation learning and learning-based manipulation initiatives.

4. Teleoperation & Human Demonstration Systems
Design and integrate teleoperation systems for humanoid robotic platforms.
Work with motion capture, VR controllers, wearable sensors, and human-to-robot motion mapping.
Develop pipelines for collecting human demonstrations and robotic manipulation data.
Optimize teleoperation latency, precision, synchronization, and operator experience.
Support scalable robotic data collection for embodied AI model training.
Collaborate with AI and Data teams to improve demonstration quality and dataset usability.

5. Robotics Software Development
Develop and maintain robotics software using Python and C++
.
Build and integrate robotic applications using ROS/ROS2
.
Develop software for robot control, motion planning, sensor integration, and data acquisition.
Integrate communication between controllers, sensors, actuators, and software modules.
Optimize software for real-time performance and reliability.
Build debugging, logging, diagnostics, and monitoring tools.
Maintain clear technical documentation and reusable robotics components.

6. Perception, Sensors & Sensor Fusion
Integrate cameras, depth sensors, IMUs, force/torque sensors, and tactile sensors.
Develop calibration and synchronization processes for multimodal sensor systems.
Support perception pipelines for object detection, tracking, localization, and robotic manipulation.
Work with visual feedback and sensor fusion to improve robotic decision-making.
Ensure accurate sensor data capture for robotic training and evaluation.

7. Simulation, Testing & Validation
Develop and validate robotic capabilities using simulation environments.
Work with tools such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or similar platforms.
Support simulation-to-real-world transfer of robotic behaviors.
Design structured testing protocols for robotic movement, manipulation, and system reliability.
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and system failures.
Establish safety procedures and operational standards for humanoid robotic systems.

8. Robotics Lab & Operational Infrastructure
Support the development and operation of CNTXT AI's robotics facility in Milpitas.
Establish robotic testing, calibration, maintenance, and deployment procedures.
Develop scalable infrastructure for teleoperation and robotic data collection.
Collaborate with operations teams to improve robot utilization and minimize downtime.
Support hardware procurement, vendor evaluation, and robotic platform selection.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to robotics engineering best practices.

Requirements

5+ years of professional experience
in robotics engineering, with significant hands-on experience working with physical robotic systems.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Direct experience with humanoid robotics, robotic manipulation, or advanced robotic platforms.
Strong proficiency in C++ and Python
.
Extensive experience with ROS/ROS2 and Linux-based robotics systems
.
Strong understanding of robot kinematics, dynamics, motion planning, and control theory.
Experience integrating motors, actuators, robotic arms, sensors, and controllers.
Experience developing and debugging robotic systems in real-world environments.
Familiarity with perception systems, sensor fusion, and robotic calibration.
Experience with robotics simulation and validation tools.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to work independently and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to work on-site at our Milpitas, California office.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with commercial or research humanoid robotic platforms.
Experience with whole-body control, locomotion, and bimanual manipulation.
Experience with dexterous robotic hands and tactile sensing.
Background in teleoperation, motion capture, and human demonstration systems.
Familiarity with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and embodied AI.
Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, or Gazebo.
Experience developing robotic data collection infrastructure.
Familiarity with robotic learning datasets, demonstrations, and evaluation methodologies.
Experience working in robotics startups, AI research laboratories, or advanced robotics companies.
Experience supporting hardware prototyping, manufacturing, and deployment.

Key Performance Indicators
Successful integration and deployment of humanoid robotic platforms.
Robot uptime, reliability, and operational readiness.
Manipulation accuracy and robotic task success rates.
Teleoperation performance and responsiveness.
Quality and consistency of robotic demonstration data.
Reduction in system failures and technical downtime.
Timely completion of robotics development and testing milestones.
Scalability and efficiency of robotic data collection systems.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

First 30 Days – Technical Assessment & Integration
Understand CNTXT AI's robotics platforms, technical infrastructure, and operational objectives.
Assess existing robotic hardware, software, and integration requirements.
Identify immediate technical challenges and improvement opportunities.
Establish testing, calibration, and debugging procedures.

Days 31–60 – Development & Optimization
Implement improvements to robotic control, manipulation, and system reliability.
Integrate teleoperation and robotic data collection capabilities.
Develop technical tools and workflows for efficient robot operation.
Validate robotic capabilities through structured testing.

Days 61–90 – Deployment & Scale
Deliver measurable improvements in robot performance and operational reliability.
Establish repeatable robotic deployment and maintenance processes.
Support scaling of robotic demonstration and data collection operations.
Develop a technical roadmap for further robotics capabilities and infrastructure.

Why Join CNTXT AI?

Work directly with advanced humanoid robotic platforms and embodied AI technologies.
Help establish and scale CNTXT AI's robotics engineering operations in Silicon Valley.
Develop real-world robotic systems supporting next-generation AI research.
Collaborate with international robotics, engineering, and AI teams.
Take ownership of robotics systems from integration and development through deployment.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Software Development
